caption: Dani watches your Telegram chats and your inbox. Six actions wait for your OK.
name: brief

caption: Open the review queue. TG is Telegram, MAIL, CAL and DRIVE are Track 4 actions.
name: queue

caption: A message from your launch group, and the reply Dani drafted. Nothing sends until you approve.
name: detail

caption: Want to say it yourself? Reply by voice.
name: listening

caption: Your words become the draft. Check it, then approve.
name: voiced

caption: Approve with one click on the temple or ring. The reply goes out to Telegram.
name: sent

caption: A channel digest: one glance, one click to mark it read.
name: digest

caption: Track 4: an email reply Dani drafted from your inbox.
name: mail

caption: Approve it. Every action leaves a receipt.
name: mail-done

caption: Share a file. This run fails on purpose in the simulator so you can see the failure path.
name: error

caption: Not sure? Reject. Dani drops it and logs it.
name: rejected

caption: Skip the last one. Queue clear.
name: clear

caption: Receipts list what ran, what was skipped and what was rejected.
name: receipts
